## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A consuming change's plan produces contract tests attributed to the consumer...

The system SHALL ensure that a consuming change's plan produces contract tests attributed to the consumer and proposed to the upstream change's owner.

#### Scenario: A consuming change's plan produces contract tests attributed to the consumer...

WHEN `consumer-contract-tests` is implemented
THEN A consuming change's plan produces contract tests attributed to the consumer and proposed to the upstream change's owner.

### Requirement: Upstream /validate-feature reports per-consumer contract test results

The system SHALL ensure that upstream /validate-feature reports per-consumer contract test results.

#### Scenario: Upstream /validate-feature reports per-consumer contract test results

WHEN `consumer-contract-tests` is implemented
THEN Upstream /validate-feature reports per-consumer contract test results.

### Requirement: A spec-split helper partitions a capability's requirements into kernel...

The system SHALL ensure that a spec-split helper partitions a capability's requirements into kernel (consumer-tested) and backlog (untested), preserving backlog rationale.

#### Scenario: A spec-split helper partitions a capability's requirements into kernel...

WHEN `consumer-contract-tests` is implemented
THEN A spec-split helper partitions a capability's requirements into kernel (consumer-tested) and backlog (untested), preserving backlog rationale.
